description: This file declares the RuntimeManagerImplementation class, which implements runtime management, configuration, and event handling for containerized applications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and external dependencies related to runtime control, container events, and system configuration.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing runtime management, configuration, and event handling for containerized applications within the WPEFramework plugin system. It manages container lifecycle events, notifications, and system configuration.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A nested class representing a dispatchable job for handling runtime events asynchronously.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for runtime events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts a containerized application with specified parameters.

methods.name: Hibernate
methods.description: Hibernates the specified application instance.

methods.name: Wake
methods.description: Wakes the specified application instance from a runtime state.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Suspends the specified application instance.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes a suspended application instance.

methods.name: Terminate
methods.description: Terminates the specified application instance.

methods.name: Kill
methods.description: Forcefully kills the specified application instance.

methods.name: GetInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific application instance.

methods.name: Annotate
methods.description: Adds metadata key-value pair to an application instance.

methods.name: Mount
methods.description: Mounts necessary resources for runtime management.

methods.name: Unmount
methods.description: Unmounts resources used for runtime management.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the runtime manager with system settings.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStartedEvent
methods.description: Handles container start events.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStoppedEvent
methods.description: Handles container stop events.

methods.name: onOCIContainerFailureEvent
methods.description: Handles container failure events.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Handles container state change events.

methods.description: Creates the OCI container plugin object.

methods.name: releaseOCIContainerPluginObject
methods.description: Releases the OCI container plugin object.

methods.name: createStorageManagerPluginObject
methods.description: Creates the storage manager plugin object.

methods.name: releaseStorageManagerPluginObject
methods.description: Releases the storage manager plugin object.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a runtime configuration specification based on application config.

methods.name: getContainerId
methods.description: Retrieves the container ID for a given application instance.

methods.name: isOCIPluginObjectValid
methods.description: Checks if the OCI plugin object is valid.

methods.name: getRuntimeState
methods.description: Gets the current runtime state of an application instance.

methods.name: getAppStorageInfo
methods.description: Retrieves storage information for an application.
